popCulture.title: Argonautica
popCulture.creator: Apollonius of Rhodes
popCulture.description: Echion of Alope, son of Hermes and brother of Erytus, sails with the Argonauts — crafty children of the thief-god, not the Theban Spartos.

popCulture.title: Echion
popCulture.description: Argonaut son of Hermes and Antianira — kept distinct from Echion the sown man of Cadmus' Thebes.
